_readme: Single source of truth for every interaction. Read RULES.md before editing. Numbers are permanent: never renumber or reuse. New interactions take the next number and new: true.

interactions.name: Blast Radius
interactions.summary: Hover a delete button and everything that goes with it is marked across the page, along with everything that stays.
interactions.tryit: Hover {Delete Project}, then click it twice. {Undo} brings it all back.

interactions.name: Heavy Save
interactions.summary: The {Save} button sinks and darkens with every unsaved change. Try to leave, and it tugs you back.
interactions.tryit: Edit two or three rows, tap {Go to Billing}, then {Save}.

interactions.name: Point-at-Error
interactions.summary: The error message points at the exact character that broke the email, and offers a fix when the fix is certain.
interactions.tryit: Press {sarah@@acme.io} or another example under the field, or type your own address.

specs.label: Pointer
specs.value: A callout points at the character

interactions.name: Coin Drop
interactions.summary: Switch to yearly and the savings fall into each plan as coins. The counter climbs as they land.
interactions.tryit: Switch to {Yearly}, then back to {Monthly}.

specs.label: Counter
specs.value: Steps up as each coin lands

interactions.name: Shortcut Reveal
interactions.summary: Hold Ctrl or ⌘ and every shortcut on the toolbar appears, rippling out from your pointer. Use one and it is marked learned.
interactions.tryit: Hold Ctrl (⌘ on Mac) and press B. On a phone, press and hold {Hold to show shortcuts}.

interactions.name: Spill Counter
interactions.summary: Type past the limit and the extra characters spill off the line, each hanging lower than the last. Trim lets them fall away.
interactions.tryit: Press {Keep Typing for Me}, or type past 80 characters. Then press {Trim}.

specs.label: Warning
specs.value: Amber with 10 left, red when over

interactions.name: Frosted Peek
interactions.summary: A Pro chart under frost. Drag across it to open a clear window and read real numbers before you pay.
interactions.tryit: Hover or drag across the chart. Use the arrow keys after tabbing to it. Then press {Unlock Forecasts}.

specs.label: Lens
specs.value: Frost with the month and value

specs.label: Unlock
specs.value: Frost wipes away in one spring

interactions.name: Refill Timer
interactions.summary: Run out of generations and the button becomes the timer, filling as the next credit returns while each dot refills like a tank.
interactions.tryit: Press {Generate} five times fast, then watch it refill.

specs.label: Credits
specs.value: 5, one back every 3s in the demo

specs.label: Dots
specs.value: Fill from the bottom as they return

specs.label: Return
specs.value: Bump and pop when a credit is back

interactions.name: File-Aware Dropzone
interactions.summary: It knows what you are dropping before you let go, then previews each type its own way: rows slide in, photos develop, pages fan out.
interactions.tryit: Drag a CSV, image or PDF over it, or press {Sample CSV}, {Sample Image} or {Sample PDF}.

specs.label: PDF
specs.value: Pages fan out, page count read

interactions.name: Ghost Caret
interactions.summary: A teammate's cursor and fresh words live inside the field. Put your cursor near theirs and they politely wait for you.
interactions.tryit: Watch Mira type, then click near her caret. Press {Replay} to watch again.

interactions.name: Honest Skeleton
interactions.summary: Known data shows at once, each part shimmers at its own pace, slow parts say so, and a failed part offers {Retry} instead of shimmering forever.
interactions.tryit: Watch it load, then press {Retry} on the chart. Press {Reload} to replay.

interactions.name: Typo Morph
interactions.summary: A search with no results morphs your typo, letter by letter, into the closest real match, then shows its results.
interactions.tryit: Press {biling} or another example, or type a misspelled setting. Press Tab to accept.

interactions.name: Clipboard Stack
interactions.summary: Copied text flies into a clipboard that keeps your last five copies, so an earlier one is one click away.
interactions.tryit: Press {Copy} on two or three values, then press {icon:Recent copies}.

interactions.name: Leaning Empty State
interactions.summary: The illustration on an empty screen turns toward the button as your pointer gets close. Click and the tiles gather into your first project.
interactions.tryit: Move toward {New Project}, then click it.

interactions.name: Session Fade
interactions.summary: As a session nears timeout the page drains of color instead of popping a modal. Any movement floods it back from your pointer.
interactions.tryit: Keep your pointer still for 10 seconds, then move it.

specs.label: Wake
specs.value: Color springs back from the pointer

interactions.name: Lock Builder
interactions.summary: Each password rule you meet slides a bolt into a padlock. Meet them all and the shackle snaps shut.
interactions.tryit: Type a password like Atlas2026!

specs.label: Lock
specs.value: Shackle closes at four of four

interactions.name: Seat Stacker
interactions.summary: Avatars stack as you add seats, prices roll like an odometer, and crossing a volume tier is celebrated.
interactions.tryit: Press {icon:Add a seat} until you reach 10 seats.

specs.label: Odometer
specs.value: Each digit rolls on a spring

specs.label: Nudge
specs.value: Shows when 3 seats from a tier

interactions.name: Snooze Slide
interactions.summary: Drag a notification right to snooze it. The further you drag, the later it comes back, with the exact time shown behind the card.
interactions.tryit: Drag a card right, past two steps, and let go. Or focus it and press the right arrow.

interactions.name: Setup Ring
interactions.summary: Finishing a setup step flies its check into a ring that fills one segment at a time. Complete it and the ring becomes a badge.
interactions.tryit: Press {Done} on each step.

interactions.name: Elastic Range
interactions.summary: The date range stretches like a rubber band toward your pointer, and strains against a booked night instead of allowing an impossible stay.
interactions.tryit: Click November {12}, then point at {24}.

interactions.name: Offline Queue
interactions.summary: Changes made offline pile up in a visible queue, then fly to the cloud one by one when you reconnect.
interactions.tryit: Switch {Online} off, check two tasks, then switch it back on.

specs.label: Reconnect
specs.value: Each change flies to the cloud

specs.label: Confirm
specs.value: Clock turns into a green check

interactions.name: Pocket Progress
interactions.summary: A long export's progress sheet morphs into a small Frost pill so you can keep working. It pings when the job is done.
interactions.tryit: Press {Export CSV}, then {Keep Working}. Click rows while it runs.

interactions.name: Unsure Underline
interactions.summary: AI text marks the words it is unsure of, with darker underlines for less certainty, and lets you settle each one in a tap.
interactions.tryit: Click an underlined word and pick an option.

interactions.name: Paper Invite
interactions.summary: Invites fold into paper planes and fly off. Addresses that can't be invited boomerang back as red chips with the reason.
interactions.tryit: Press {Fill Sample Emails}, then {Send Invites}.

interactions.name: Preview Palette
interactions.summary: A command palette that previews each command live on the page before you commit. Escape puts everything back.
interactions.tryit: Open {Commands}, arrow through the options, then press Enter or Escape.

specs.label: Revert
specs.value: Escape, click away, or leave the list

interactions.name: Token Taximeter
interactions.summary: A taxi meter runs as you type a prompt, so you see what it will cost, and how much of the budget it uses, before you send it.
interactions.tryit: Type into the prompt, then switch to {Smart} and {Long}.

specs.label: Fare
specs.value: Odometer digits roll on a spring

specs.label: Budget
specs.value: Spent so far plus this prompt

interactions.name: Approval Stamp
interactions.summary: Approving or declining lands an ink stamp with who decided and when. Undo lifts it back off.
interactions.tryit: Press {Approve}, then {Undo}. Try {Decline}, which asks for a reason first.

interactions.name: Lasso Select
interactions.summary: Draw a free-form loop around files to select them. Files light up as the loop reaches them, and a count follows your pointer.
interactions.tryit: Draw a loop around a few files. Hold Shift and draw again to add more.

interactions.name: Archive Drawer
interactions.summary: Archived messages fly into a little drawer that visibly fills up. Open it to put anything back.
interactions.tryit: Press {Archive} on two messages, then open the drawer and press {Restore} on one.

interactions.name: Sort Trace
interactions.summary: When a table re-sorts, each row glides to its new place and leaves a fading trail showing where it came from and how far it moved.
interactions.tryit: Click {MRR}, then {Account}, then {MRR} again.

interactions.name: Step Fold
interactions.summary: Finished steps fold up into summary chips, so the form stays short and every answer is one tap away from editing.
interactions.tryit: Press {Continue} through the steps, then tap a chip to change an answer.

specs.label: Fold
specs.value: Folds up around its top edge

specs.label: Edit
specs.value: Tap a chip to unfold it

interactions.name: Rewind Scrub
interactions.summary: Drag back through a document's history and watch each edit undo itself in place, with who made it and when.
interactions.tryit: Drag the scrubber left, then press {Restore This Version}.

interactions.name: Due Heat
interactions.summary: Due dates warm up continuously as they approach, from calm gray to blue, amber and red, and pulse faster in the final day.
interactions.tryit: Drag {Move Time Forward} slowly to the right.

specs.label: Heat
specs.value: Eases in over the last 3 days

specs.label: Overdue
specs.value: Solid red and a single shake

interactions.name: Scope Chips
interactions.summary: Typing from:mira or in:billing morphs into a colored chip. Backspace into a chip and it melts back into editable text.
interactions.tryit: Type from:mi then a space, then in:b. Press Backspace twice.

specs.label: Melt
specs.value: Backspace turns it back to text

interactions.name: Access Ladder
interactions.summary: Choosing who can open a link climbs a ladder, and a crowd beside it shows exactly how many people that lets in.
interactions.tryit: Click each rung from {Only You} up to {Anyone with the Link}.

specs.label: Ladder
specs.value: Rail fills to the chosen rung

interactions.name: Could've Been an Email
interactions.summary: A short meeting with no agenda quietly folds itself into an envelope, and works out how many hours sending it would give back.
interactions.tryit: Wait a second. Then try {It Really Needs a Meeting}, or type an agenda.

interactions.name: Anxious Typing Dots
interactions.summary: The typing indicator gets more nervous the longer they type. It grows, speeds up, shakes, deletes everything, and sends "yes".
interactions.tryit: Watch it play, then press {Replay}.

specs.label: Stages
specs.value: Typing to a novel in 7 steps

interactions.name: Rage Click Detector
interactions.summary: Click a busy button again and again and it notices, tells you how long is really left, promises only one job started, and hands you a stress ball.
interactions.tryit: Press {Export PDF}, then click it five times fast. Squeeze the ball.

interactions.name: AI Flip-Flop
interactions.summary: Ask the assistant "Are you sure?" and it changes its answer, while its confidence badge shrinks, turns red and starts to sweat.
interactions.tryit: Press {Are You Sure?} until it pulls itself together.

interactions.name: Terms Speedrun
interactions.summary: Scroll through the terms at an impossible speed and the checkbox admits what really happened, then gives you the short version.
interactions.tryit: Flick the terms to the bottom as fast as you can.

interactions.name: LGTM (Didn't Look)
interactions.summary: Approve a 2,000-line pull request seconds after opening it, and the approval stamp tells everyone what really happened.
interactions.tryit: Press {Approve} right away. Then {Undo}, scroll the whole diff and approve again.

specs.label: Timer
specs.value: Starts when the review is on screen

specs.label: Viewed
specs.value: Follows how far the diff is scrolled

interactions.name: Friday Deploy Hard Hat
interactions.summary: After 4 PM on a Friday, {Deploy} puts on a hard hat and caution tape, makes you hold it for two seconds, and offers Monday instead.
interactions.tryit: Hold {Deploy} for two seconds, or let go early. Try {Tue 11 AM} for comparison.

specs.label: Hat
specs.value: Drops in on a pop spring

interactions.name: Commit Mood Ring
interactions.summary: Commit messages are read as feelings. From “fix” to “pls work”, the mood ring slides from calm aqua to quiet acceptance.
interactions.tryit: Tap {fix}, {fix again}, {final fix} and {pls work} in order.

specs.label: Score
specs.value: Words like fix, again, pls, why

specs.label: Moods
specs.value: Calm to Acceptance in six steps

interactions.name: Rubber Duck Gate
interactions.summary: Before you file a bug, a rubber duck asks you to explain it first. It nods along, and half the time you solve it yourself.
interactions.tryit: Press {File Bug}, then explain the problem in two sentences.

specs.label: Joy
specs.value: A backflip when you solve it

interactions.name: final_FINAL_v3
interactions.summary: Every save renames the file one step further: final, final_v2, FINAL, FINAL_final_v3 (use this one)… and back to where it started.
interactions.tryit: Press {Save} over and over, or ⌘S with focus inside.

interactions.name: Tone Thermometer
interactions.summary: Passive-aggressive phrases drop the temperature of your message until it frosts over. One button warms it up with friendlier words.
interactions.tryit: Press {As previously mentioned} and watch the frost spread, then press {Warm It Up}.

interactions.name: Quick Question Stopwatch
interactions.summary: Start a message with “quick question” and a stopwatch starts too, following the thread until it admits this is a meeting now.
interactions.tryit: Press {Send} and watch the thread unfold.

specs.label: Verdict
specs.value: Quick to meeting in four steps

interactions.name: Circle Back Boomerang
interactions.summary: “Let’s circle back next week” becomes a boomerang. Send it and it spins away, then flies back a week later as a reminder.
interactions.tryit: Press {Send}, then {Skip Ahead a Week}.

specs.label: Phrases
specs.value: Circle back, follow up, touch base

interactions.name: Exclamation Budget
interactions.summary: You get three exclamation marks per message. Spend them, and any more quietly turn into periods while the field shrugs.
interactions.tryit: Tap {Add “!”}, then {Add “!!!”}. Then buy {3 More for $0.99}.

specs.label: Refund
specs.value: Delete one to get it back

interactions.name: Attachment Shrug
interactions.summary: Write “see the attached deck” with nothing attached and the {Send} button shrugs at you instead of sending.
interactions.tryit: Press {Send}. Then press {Attach File} and send again.

interactions.name: Mute Mime
interactions.summary: Talk while muted and your voice bounces off an invisible glass box around your tile, like a mime. Then it tells you you’re on mute.
interactions.tryit: Hold {Hold to Talk} for two seconds. Then press {Unmute} and hold again.

interactions.name: Camera-Off Curtain
interactions.summary: Turning your camera off draws red velvet theater curtains across your tile. Turning it on opens the show with a spotlight.
interactions.tryit: Press {Turn Camera Off}, wait a second, then press {Turn Camera On}.

specs.label: Curtains
specs.value: Slide in on a pop spring

interactions.name: Overtime Fuse
interactions.summary: Once a meeting runs past its end time, the progress bar becomes a burning fuse, with a running count of person-minutes.
interactions.tryit: Drag {Move Time Forward} past 30 minutes.

specs.label: After
specs.value: A rope burning right to left

specs.label: Nudge
specs.value: {End Meeting for All} pulses at 5 min

interactions.name: Line Clear
interactions.summary: Accepted meetings drop into your day like falling blocks. Fill every gap and the day flashes like a cleared line, then offers to protect lunch.
interactions.tryit: Press {Accept} on all three invites, then {Protect 12:00 for Lunch}.

interactions.name: Over-the-Shoulder Cursor
interactions.summary: A teammate’s cursor lingering on your paragraph puts on tiny reading glasses, then leans in. Start typing and it darts away.
interactions.tryit: Wait for the glasses, then type in the first paragraph.

specs.label: Startle
specs.value: Typing sends it to a corner

interactions.name: Dusty Doc
interactions.summary: A document nobody has opened in years loads covered in dust, with a cobweb in the corner. Scrolling or swiping blows it all away.
interactions.tryit: Scroll the page up and down, or swipe across it fast.

specs.label: Scroll
specs.value: Blows a share off each move

interactions.name: Autosave Appreciation
interactions.summary: Press ⌘S in an app that already autosaves and it thanks you for the gesture, getting more philosophical the more you press.
interactions.tryit: Click into the notes and press ⌘S or Ctrl+S a few times.

interactions.name: Unsubscribe Comes to You
interactions.summary: The opposite of the button that runs away. {Unsubscribe} slides toward your cursor, grows, and says {Yes, This One}. One click, done.
interactions.tryit: Move your mouse toward {Unsubscribe} and let it come to you.

specs.label: Pull
specs.value: Moves 62% of the way to you

interactions.name: Dizzy Refresh
interactions.summary: Pull to refresh again and again and the spinner gets woozy, then dizzy with spinning eyes, then offers to just tell you when something arrives.
interactions.tryit: Pull the list down, or press {icon:Refresh} five times quickly.

interactions.name: Aging Reminder
interactions.summary: Every snooze makes the reminder visibly older: yellowed, curled, taped back up, coffee-stained. {Done} snaps it fresh again.
interactions.tryit: Press {Snooze 1 Hour} five or six times, then {Done}.

interactions.name: Cancel, Eventually
interactions.summary: Reach for {Cancel Subscription} and it swaps places with {Keep My Plan}, so you land on Keep instead. Five times. Then it gets tired, walks back, and lets you leave.
interactions.tryit: Move your mouse onto {Cancel Subscription}. Keep chasing it.

specs.label: Swaps
specs.value: Five, Cancel left and Keep right
